social_media.headline: Significant Space Weather Event Ongoing
social_media.summary: Multiple coronal mass ejections reached Earth beginning Friday, producing G3–G5 geomagnetic storming. The event remains ongoing, with renewed CME impacts expected Sunday.

confidence.label: Status
confidence.detail: The Space Weather Warning remains in effect through 1800 UTC Sunday.

what_we_know: Multiple CME impacts began at 1639 UTC Friday.
Particle storm conditions reached SP2, and Active Region 3664 produced an X5.8 flare.
Storming remains in progress; additional G5 periods are possible.

footer.left: Warning remains in effect through 1800 UTC Sunday.

visual.alt_text: Operational visualization summarizing the ongoing May 2024 space weather event.
